SELECT currency_name FROM currencies WHERE currency_code = #{currencyCode}
SELECT currency_code FROM currencies WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT c.currency_code AS currencyCode, c.currency_name AS currencyName, er.deal_base_rate AS dealBaseRate, er.prev_rate AS prevRate, (er.deal_base_rate - IFNULL(er.prev_rate, er.deal_base_rate)) AS changeAmount, er.rate_date AS rateDate FROM exchange_rates er JOIN currencies c ON er.target_currency_id = c.id WHERE er.rate_date = (SELECT MAX(rate_date) FROM exchange_rates) ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.currency_code IN ('JPY', 'EUR', 'CHF', 'THB', 'USD') THEN 0 WHEN c.currency_code IN ('GBP', 'CAD', 'AUD', 'CNH', 'HKD') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, c.currency_code LIMIT 10

SELECT era.id AS id, c.currency_code AS currencyCode, era.target_rate AS targetRate, era.target_amount AS targetAmount FROM exchange_rate_alerts era INNER JOIN currencies c ON era.currency_id = c.id WHERE era.user_id = #{userId} AND era.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exchange_rate_alerts (user_id, currency_id, target_rate, target_amount, is_deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{currencyId}, #{targetRate}, #{targetAmount}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT er.rate_date AS rateDate, er.deal_base_rate AS dealBaseRate FROM exchange_rates er JOIN currencies c ON er.target_currency_id = c.id WHERE c.currency_code = #{currencyCode} AND er.rate_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY er.rate_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exchange_rates (base_currency_id, target_currency_id, currency_unit, deal_base_rate, prev_rate, rate_date, fetched_at) VALUES (#{baseCurrencyId}, #{targetCurrencyId}, #{currencyUnit}, #{dealBaseRate}, #{prevRate}, #{rateDate}, #{fetchedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deal_base_rate = VALUES(deal_base_rate), prev_rate = VALUES(prev_rate), fetched_at = VALUES(fetched_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE exchange_rate_alerts SET target_rate = #{request.targetRate}, target_amount = #{request.targetAmount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE exchange_rate_alerts SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
